Package com.nexuslink.protocol.rabbitmq

Class DeadLetterArgs

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.rabbitmq.DeadLetterArgs
public final class DeadLetterArgs extends Object
Pure builder for the x-* arguments passed to a queue.declare so that messages dead-letter to another exchange. Produces the argument map AMQP clients expect:
  • x-dead-letter-exchange — exchange that rejected/expired/over-length messages are republished to;
  • x-dead-letter-routing-key — routing key to use instead of the message's original one (optional);
  • x-message-ttl — per-queue message time-to-live, in milliseconds, after which a message expires and is dead-lettered (optional);
  • x-max-length — maximum ready-message count before the overflow policy kicks in (optional);
  • x-overflow — overflow behaviour, e.g. reject-publish or drop-head (optional).

The builder is immutable-friendly: each setter returns this, and build() returns a fresh, insertion-ordered map that the caller owns.
